rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.catalyst: Sunday, US markets closed — spot crypto only. Week 41: BTC -2.1% w/w vs ETH -6.8% and SOL -8.1%; BTC dominance 59.1%. ETH ETFs have zero inflow days in October; SOL ETFs 5 straight outflow days. ~$106M liquidations in 24h, possible Iran-linked crypto seizure headline.
positions.driver: No fresh weekend catalyst = low-edge day; stay in the lowest-vol major with the clearest relative strength and dominance tailwind. Beat ETH-USD (persistent ETF outflows), SOL-USD (highest weekly drawdown, ETF bleed), XRP-USD (no catalyst). Monday re-opens the equity universe.
positions.risks: Weekend geopolitical/oil headline, hawkish Fed repricing, thin Sunday-night liquidity / liquidation cascade into Asia open. Hard stop 74603.74 (-10%).
